content:
liam: Quick heads-up — I saw a regression after the q4 quant bring-up. It shows up only on inputs with ideographic variation sequences (IVS). BLEU on our zh->ja mix set dropped ~2.3 vs float baseline. Repro and minimal examples below.

liam: repro (run on aegis-v1-q4):
```
> echo -n "漢\uE0100字" | ./tokenize --model models/aegis-v1-q4 | jq -R -s -c 'split(" ")'
["漢","\uE0100","字"]
```
expected tokens (float): ["漢字"] or ["漢","字"] depending on segmentation, but not a preserved VS token in the middle. The q4 outputs are inserting/keeping the variation selector as its own token which shifts detokenization.

marta: do you have a short real-sentence example?

liam: yep — here's one that flips meaning in a small eval: 
```
input: "這個字(漢\uE0100字)在古書裡有不同版本。"
float decode: "這個字(漢字)在古書裡有不同版本。"
q4 decode: "這個字(漢\uE0100 字)在古書裡有不同版本。"
```
notice the extra space inserted after the VS token when detokenizing. That causes BLEU penalty and breaks exact-match checks in our QA.

raj: interesting. any idea whether this is tokenization change or runtime KVCACHE/kernel behavior?

liam: looked at tokenmap for aegis-v1-q4 — the mapper includes an explicit token for the VS codepoint (U+E0100), likely introduced during vocab re-mapping in the quant pipeline. The float model's vocab had a merged representation and our quantization script rebuilt the token index differently.

kai: can you paste the small diff from maptable?

liam: small snippet:
```
# maptable excerpt (before -> after)
"漢字" -> token_id 2345  # float
"漢" -> 2345; "\uE0100" -> 9876; "字" -> 2346  # q4 rebuilt
```

marta: if the quant pipeline resegmented tokens we probably broke detok postprocessing which expects certain merges. Did you run the detok regression tests?

liam: ran our local smoke suite, the specific IVS cases weren't covered. Adding tests now.

sasha: I can add a unit to detok/regression that covers IVS + ZWJ + narrow no-break combos. Will add ~10 tiny samples.

raj: let's triage: potential root causes = (1) vocab remap change during packaging, (2) tokenization script differences (sentencepiece retrain vs copy), (3) detok rule that strips control codepoints but now sees them as tokens.

liam: agreed. first quick mitigation is to canonicalize IVS before tokenization at our entrypoint for a canary route. e.g., normalize to base char + remove VS if we don't need glyph variant. But that might lose information for specialized tasks.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for aegis-v1-q4 -> canary-asia at 2026-03-21T18:40:00Z (rollout id r-2026-03-21-457).

kai: can we do a narrow canary that applies a pre-tokenize normalizer for language zh/ja only and compare metrics? If yes, we can decide whether to patch pipeline or add normalizer fallback.

marta: yes, run both: (A) normalizer at API edge, (B) rebuild vocab with original segmentation mapping and reprovision q4. We'll compare BLEU + detok-exact.

liam: timeline proposal: I will open an issue and link model artifacts + small repro. Sasha will add regression tests. Raj — could you try a quick re-map using the float vocab order and see how the q4 file looks? Might be a 15–30m job.

raj: on it, starting remap now. Will post diff when done.

sasha: tests added in PR #4821 — small cases for IVS, ZWJ, NBSP combos. CI will run overnight but I also ran them locally against float and q4; local shows fail on q4 for 7/10 samples.

liam: thanks. attaching the short eval run I did:
```
Model: aegis-v1-q4
BLEU (zh->ja mixset): 28.1
Float baseline: 30.4
Exact detok matches: 92.3% -> 86.7%
```

kai: that's meaningful. If remap fixes tokenization we should patch packaging script to preserve original token ids for special codepoints.

raj: remap attempt done — quick diff looks promising. q4 file now maps VS to the same token id as its previous combined mapping (effectively invisible). Local smoke decode now matches float detok for the samples.

liam: awesome. can you push artifact to S3 staging and I'll run full eval?

raj: uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/models/aegis-v1-q4-remap-20260321.tar.gz

marta: schedule full eval on nightly cluster (zh/ja mixset + cross-locale stress). Kai, do you want Canary A/B config?

kai: yes — Canary A = original q4, Canary B = remapped q4 with edge normalizer off. We'll compare latencies and BLEU. No need to change runtime kernels.

deploy-bot: canary A/B run queued (job id j-7789). Results expected in ~45m.

sasha: once we confirm, I'll add the IVS cases to our permanent eval suite so this doesn't slip again. Also adding a short doc in model-onboarding checklist: "preserve special-codepoint token ids".

liam: thanks everyone — will follow up with issue linking diffs + eval results. If remap holds we should roll to dedicated after chart approval.

raj: preliminary canary results: BLEU A=28.0, BLEU B=30.3, exact detok B matches float on our 1500-sample subset. Looks like remap fixes it.

marta: great — I'll prep a short postmortem and onboarding checklist update.

liam: filing issue now: https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-8673 (includes repro, artifacts, remap patch). cc @kai @sasha

kai: thanks — we should also add an automated check during quant packaging that compares detok outputs for a small locale-targeted suite. That would have caught this.

sasha: agreed. PR for tests + packaging guard queued.

liam: closing the thread here after we confirm dedicated roll. Will update ML-8673 with rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
